card.text: Explore Cressida, an inner moon of Uranus, through its measured shape.

introduction.text: Cressida is an elongated inner moon of Uranus. Its gravitational influence on the eta ring lets researchers estimate its mass.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: A 92 × 74 × 74 km shape estimate. Two axes are assumed equal; gray grid: no imagery, not observed terrain.
